info.name: Dev Events API
info.description:
API collection for Dev Events Next.js 16 app.

Base URL variable: {{base_url}} = http://localhost:3000

NOTE: POST /api/events requires an actual image file upload (not a URL).
Select any .jpg/.png from your local machine in the 'image' field.

variable.description: Slug is auto-generated from the title. 'Cloud Next 2026' => 'cloud-next-2026'

request.description: Returns all events sorted by newest first.

Fetch a single event by its slug. Slug is auto-generated from the title on creation.

Example: title 'Cloud Next 2026' => slug 'cloud-next-2026'

formdata.value: Google's premier cloud computing event, showcasing innovations in AI, infrastructure, and enterprise solutions.

Cloud Next 2025 highlights the latest in cloud-native development, Kubernetes, AI, and enterprise scalability. Developers, architects, and executives gather to learn about new Google Cloud services, best practices, and success stories.

formdata.description: Required. Select a local image file (.jpg, .png, etc). It will be uploaded to Cloudinary.
Required. Format: HH:MM (24-hour) or HH:MM AM/PM
Required. Allowed values: online | offline | hybrid

formdata.value: Cloud engineers, DevOps, enterprise leaders, AI researchers
Google Cloud organizes Cloud Next to connect global businesses, developers, and innovators with the latest technologies and best practices in cloud computing.

formdata.description: Required. Must be a JSON array string. At least one tag required.

formdata.value: ["08:30 AM - 09:30 AM | Keynote: AI-Driven Cloud Infrastructure","09:45 AM - 11:00 AM | Deep Dives: Kubernetes, Data Analytics, Security","11:15 AM - 12:30 PM | Product Demos & Networking","12:30 PM - 01:30 PM | Lunch","01:30 PM - 03:00 PM | Workshops: Scaling with GCP","03:15 PM - 04:30 PM | Fireside Chat: The Future of Enterprise Cloud"]
formdata.description: Required. Must be a JSON array string. At least one item required.

request.description:
Creates a new event. Sends multipart/form-data.

⚠️ IMPORTANT:
- 'image' must be a real file upload (not a URL)
- 'tags' and 'agenda' must be JSON array strings
- 'mode' must be exactly: online | offline | hybrid

The slug is auto-generated from the title on the server.
